title: Cech double complex of a specified injective resolution
statement: Let C be a category with v-small Hom sets and finite wide pullbacks, J a Grothendieck topology with sheafification for v-small abelian groups, F an abelian sheaf, I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], X an object of C, and pi_i : U_i → X a family indexed by a type in universe v. Define D by applying the Cech complex functor [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex] to the underlying presheaves of I, restricted to Over X, termwise, and exchanging the two complex indices. Its outer degree is Cech degree p and inner degree is resolution degree q: D^(p,q) is the product of I^q evaluated on the (p+1)-fold fibre products. The differentials commute by naturality of the Cech functor. The construction has no covering hypothesis.
